product_metadata.title: reCAP Zero Waste Kit for Mason Jars - BLACK | Made in the USA | Leak-proof | No-break material
features: MADE IN USA: reCAP is a small, woman-owned business that makes its products in Erie, Pennsylvania.
UNRIVALED QUALITY: reCAP Mason Jars lids are a leader in Mason jar accessories for their durability (made of no-break plastic), value, and design. They are leak-proof and stain-resistant.
ECO-FRIENDLY: reCAP Mason Jars lids are reusable and, made of smart plastic, can eliminate single-use plastics.
STANDARDIZED SIZE: These Pour Caps and Drinking Lids fit regular and wide-mouth Mason jars such as Atlas, Ball, Bernardin, Golden Harvest, Kerr, Legacy, Orchard Road, and Quattro Stagioni.

MULTI-PURPOSE: This reCAP Mason Jars Set has nearly endless uses. Turn your Mason jar into a water bottle on the go with our fold-out carry loop. A great storage container for dry goods or liquid. Organize your kitchen, bath, home, or office.
